title: きゅうしょくのじかん (Kyuushoku no Jikan)
description: School lunch time (kyuushoku) at a Japanese elementary school — students take turns serving food in aprons and masks, everyone says itadakimasu, and the class discovers today's menu is everyone's favourite: curry rice. A story about cooperation, sharing, and the joy of eating together.
author: オリジナル
